verdict.rationale: uv documents explicit migration paths from the incumbent pip ecosystem: a drop-in `uv pip` interface for pip/pip-tools/virtualenv workflows, and a documented `uv add -r requirements.txt` flag to import existing dependency lists into a uv project (uv-docs-42, uv-docs-31, uv-docs-5). Community reports corroborate real-world switching (uv-comm-2, uv-comm-15) but also note friction during transition, e.g. missing `--user` flag and needing to fall back to `uv pip` (uv-comm-8, uv-comm-16), so migration is not fully seamless. Missing for 10: dedicated conversion tooling for Poetry/Pipenv/conda lockfiles or pyproject formats, and independent hands-on verification of a smooth full-project migration.
